description: Records that the participant has already paid someone back (settling up); the amount defaults to what they owe that person. It records a completed payment only and moves no money. Use when the user says the money was actually sent.

allow_duplicate.description: Only if the user confirms a second, identical payment within 10 minutes (otherwise it is treated as a retry).

amount.description: Optional; defaults to the suggested settle-up amount.

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character plan ID. Links without a plan ID (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/when) are unsaved local drafts and are not accepted.

to_participant_id.description: Who received the money (participant_id, or their exact name).

name: record_payment
title: Record a payment
